facts.fact: The Council of Ministers communique of 5 August 2026 reports the Minister of Economic Affairs presenting preliminary results of the eighth Enquete Permanente sur les Conditions de Vie des menages (EPCV), fielded across 2025-2026, with monetary poverty falling from 28.2% in 2019 to 25.7% in 2025.
